Answer: B
Reason: The radiograph demonstrates lucent streaks of air in the mediastinum and extensive subcutaneous emphysema in the neck, alongside a peripheral reticular pattern in the mid-to-lower lung zones. These findings are characteristic of spontaneous pneumomediastinum associated with interstitial lung disease (such as dermatomyositis), which is typically managed conservatively in the absence of tension physiology or esophageal rupture.
